BRIEF

WHAT WE ARE MAKING, IN FIVE WORDS.

The one job
ONE SENTENCE. IF IT NEEDS "AND", IT IS TWO BRIEFS.
Audience
WHO READS IT, AND WHAT THEY KNOW ALREADY. "EVERYONE" IS NOT AN AUDIENCE.
What it must do
  • ONE THING.
  • ANOTHER.
What would make it wrong
THE FAILURE CONDITION, NAMED. THIS FIELD IS WHY THE BRIEF EXISTS — IT IS THE ONLY ONE THAT CAN BE CHECKED AGAINST THE FINISHED WORK.
Format & length
SURFACE, PAGE OR SLIDE COUNT, AND THE TEMPLATE IT STARTS FROM.
Constraints
DEADLINE · BUDGET · ANYTHING FIXED.
Who says yes
A NAME. NOT A TEAM.
Sources
WHERE THE FACTS COME FROM. NOTHING IN THE FINISHED WORK MAY COME FROM ANYWHERE ELSE.

Everything above is decided before production starts. A brief filled in after the work exists is a description, and it constrains nothing.
